Synopsis:
Karlach and Wyll meet at the camp and start a discussion. If not defused by the player it could escalate to Wyll or Karlach permanently leaving the party hostile.

Cluster Contexts:
- CAMP_WyllConfrontation_IVB_CFM.json: Karlach and Wyll are having a heated, face‑to‑face confrontation at the camp with the player standing between them. Karlach is a former gladiator of Zariel from Avernus who insists she fled the Blood War and is a victim, not an agent, and the player even experiences her traumatic visions. Wyll is the famed Blade of the Frontiers and a relentless devil‑hunter who distrusts anything tied to Zariel; he fears repercussions from his patron (Mizora) if he lets a suspected devil live. If the argument isn’t calmed by the player it can spiral into violence or a permanent, hostile split from the party.
- WYR_GortashConfrontation_OM_KarlachAndGortashEncounter_COM.json: Karlach confronts Gortash after ceremony in WYR.In this dialogue, Karlach is facing the man who sold her to the devil. She hasn't talked to him in 10 years and she's furious for his betrayal. The player can allow Karlach to fight him here, but in most cases they won't.
- CAMP_WyllConfrontation_NotRecruited_CFM.json: Wyll appears at camp to confront Karlach, if she was recruited first or is avatar and met Wyll.
- Wyll_Recruitment_PostDruidAttack_PostEA.json: Post EADialogue with Wyll after Druid Attack. In most cases, this will involve him training a tiefling child before the player breaks in, and you discover you were both on the mind flayer ship. Wyll comes across as a big-time hero, and wants help killing goblins. He is called the Blade of Frontiers by most.
- Wyll_Recruitment_PostEA.json: Post EA dialog version.Initial dialogue with Wyll. In most cases, this will involve him training a tiefling child before the player breaks in, and you discover you were both on the mind flayer ship. Wyll comes across as a big-time hero, and wants help killing goblins. He is called the Blade of Frontiers by most.

context: Karlach and Wyll are in a tense, face‑to‑face confrontation at the camp with the player caught between them. Karlach is a tiefling who once fought as Zariel’s gladiator in Avernus but claims she fled the Blood War and is a victim rather than a willing agent; the player may have even experienced her traumatic visions that show this. Wyll is the famous Blade of the Frontiers, a relentless devil‑hunter who deeply distrusts anything tied to Zariel and fears repercussions from his patron (Mizora) if he lets a suspected devil live. If the player doesn’t calm the argument it can turn violent or cause either Wyll or Karlach to permanently leave the party hostile.
